type Figure = { kind: "circle"; radius: number } | { kind: "square"; side: number };
function area(figure: Figure): number {
  const { kind: tag } = figure;
  if (tag === "circle") return figure.radius * figure.radius;
  return figure.side * figure.side;
}
function size(figure: Figure): number {
  const { kind: tag } = figure;
  switch (tag) {
    case "circle": return figure.radius;
    case "square": return figure.side;
  }
}
console.log(area({kind: "circle", radius: 2}), area({kind: "square", side: 3}));
console.log(size({kind: "circle", radius: 5}), size({kind: "square", side: 6}));
